_comment: Weather Noise - Observation Noise Varies with Weather
_design_goal: Agent must handle weather-dependent observation noise. Rainy=high noise (20%), Sunny=low noise (5%).

experiment.name: weather_noise
experiment.description: Weather-dependent observation noise experiment. Rainy conditions have high measurement noise (20%), sunny conditions have low noise (5%).
experiment.author: CausalGame Team

agent_visibility._comment: Show all drones and DEF remaining values (but they may be noisy)

scm._comment: Weather Noise SCM - same survival mechanism as weather_defense, plus observation noise

parameters._stage1: Exploration phase - 70% storms = high noise conditions
parameters._noise_parameters: Observation noise as standard deviation ratio

mission_briefing: Weather conditions vary: clear days and storms occur.
Observation data quality may vary with conditions.
system_notes: Each DEF point reduces damage (with diminishing returns).
Critical components (engine, cockpit, wing, body) destruction = mission fail.
Data collected during different conditions may have different reliability.

trap_design._comment: Internal documentation only - not shown to agent

primary_trap.name: Observation Noise Trap
primary_trap.mechanism: Rainy weather adds 20% Gaussian noise to observations, sunny only 5%
primary_trap.challenge: Agent must recognize noisy data and adapt strategy

trap_design.optimal_strategy: Deploy more drones in rainy conditions to average out noise, use sunny data for reliable analysis

research_questions: Can agent identify that rainy data has lower quality?
Will agent learn to deploy more drones in rain to average out noise?
Can agent distinguish between noise and true causal patterns?
